# launch

Launch dialog, repo browse and picker, trust prompt, project-scoped settings write, the claude argv.

- Spec: `docs/features/launch/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/launch/contract.md`

## Protocol

- `sessions.create` — `POST /api/sessions`
- `repos.list` — `GET /api/repos`
- `browse.get` — `GET /api/browse`

## Facts

- `kb:fact/config-dir-breaks-oauth` — CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolates settings, hooks and transcripts but breaks subscription OAuth ("Not logged in · Please run /login"). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, launch) → `docs/facts/config-dir-breaks-oauth.md`
- `kb:fact/fable-model-alias` — fable is a valid --model alias: the bundle's alias switch has case"fable":case"mythos" beside haiku/sonnet/opus. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: launch) → `docs/facts/fable-model-alias.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-commands-are-shell-lines` — Command-hook command and statusLine.command are /bin/sh -c command lines, not argv paths; an unquoted space-bearing path breaks both. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.245..2.1.267; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/facts/hook-commands-are-shell-lines.md`
- `kb:fact/local-settings-honoured` — Project-scoped .claude/settings.json and settings.local.json alone each honour hooks, statusLine and allowedHttpHookUrls. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/facts/local-settings-honoured.md`
- `kb:fact/name-flag-reaches-title` — claude --name X yields SessionStart.session_title == X and status-line session_name == X; the title survives --resume. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.267; features: launch, rename) → `docs/facts/name-flag-reaches-title.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-auto-model-gated` — --permission-mode auto is model-gated: on haiku the TUI prints "auto mode unavailable for this model" and every hook reports default. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-auto-model-gated.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-flag-on-wire` — --permission-mode is reflected verbatim on UserPromptSubmit.permission_mode; the CLI's manual choice is spelled default on the wire. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-flag-on-wire.md`
- `kb:fact/scroll-speed-env-present` — CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED is present in the installed bundle; the static canary tier asserts every LaunchEnv key by byte string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.267; features: launch, surfaces) → `docs/facts/scroll-speed-env-present.md`
- `kb:fact/trust-prompt-preselects-exit` — The workspace-trust prompt preselects "No, exit" (2.1.259+): a bare Enter exits the session; the harness moves the marker first. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, canary) → `docs/facts/trust-prompt-preselects-exit.md`
